messages:
Lina: Morning team — quick async standup. Drop Y/T/D/B (yesterday / today / blockers). I'll go first.

Sam: Y: finished the autoscale policy tests for Dedicated. Put config PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2145. T: waiting on reviews, then will run canary. B: need a second pair of eyes on the 95th-pct latency regression.

Priya: Y: triaged last night's alert (blk-az1). Root cause was stray router rule. Cleared and added guard. T: prepping playbook update. B: need confirmation that the monitor thresholds are OK for the new region.

Marcus: Y: landed rollout plan for private beta customers. T: sync with infra on cutover window (cc @Sam). B: one customer asked for earlier migration; considering options.

Zoe: Y: finished eval set for v1.2 quantized model. Observed slight drop on long-form Qs. T: running diff-eval and debugging tokenization mismatch. B: need access to the failing prompt list from product.

Devin: Y: closed the small UX bug on console token meter. T: pairing with Sam later to wire the new error banner. B: none.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy to prod at 2026-03-17T16:30Z by @Sam. Jobs: runtime v2.3.4, api-service deploy. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/1938765432

Lina: Quick asks — please review Sam's PR today if possible :pray:. Priya, can you drop the monitor threshold suggestion inline on the alert PR? Zoe, I'll DM the prompt set. Devin, let's do pairing at 14:00 UTC.

Maya: heads-up — all-hands at 17:00 UTC today. Topic: dedicated beta customer updates and SRE runbook changes. If you have one slide, drop to #all-hands-deck.

Sam: noted re: PR. I'll ping reviewers and post perf histogram in the PR comment (ps: used `bench --trace` locally).

Priya: will add thresholds and ack after tests.

Zoe: got it — thank you Lina. share when ready.

Devin: 14:00 UTC works :+1:

Marcus: I'll be at all-hands, adding a 2-slide summary.

Lina: perfect. If anyone has blockers after this thread, DM me or add to #eng-oncall. Thanks :rocket:
